 Edaad Schema Architect is an AI-powered visual database designer built for the WebMCP Challenge. Traditionally, AI can only suggest SQL in a text box. But with WebMCP, ChatGPT directly manipulates a real-time, visual canvas in the browser. Features include conversational schema building, intelligent consistency checks (like soft deletes), safe refactoring, and advanced ORM export (Prisma).
